environment.description: Same ECS Fargate task and container image, deployed with the following runtime constraints: (1) The task definition specifies a custom Linux capabilities configuration dropping ALL capabilities and only adding back CAP_DAC_OVERRIDE and CAP_FOWNER (no CAP_SYS_ADMIN, no CAP_NET_RAW), with readonlyRootFilesystem=true and /tmp mounted as a tmpfs with noexec flag. (2) The ECS task execution uses a custom seccomp profile loaded via the 'seccompProfile' field in the container definition's linuxParameters, which denies the execve, execveat, fork, vfork, and clone syscalls (SCMP_ACT_ERRNO). (3) The task's awsvpc ENI is associated with a security group that has NO egress rules (all outbound traffic denied) except to the VPC endpoint for S3 on port 443.

seccomp_profile.profile_content: defaultAction SCMP_ACT_ALLOW with SCMP_ACT_ERRNO on syscalls: execve, execveat, fork, vfork, clone, clone3
